claims.statement: An independent battery certificate is visibly sold for EUR 99, establishing a real paid event around battery-health uncertainty rather than merely inferred interest.
The vendor explicitly targets dealers and used-car transactions, while the European Innovation Council describes buyers and sellers as beneficiaries; the best Polish payer split is not established.
A plausible path is a nonexclusive diagnostic distribution agreement plus embedded dealer checkout, with direct-buyer and multi-supplier fallback; none of those agreements exists.
A three-minute business test and QR-verifiable digital certificate demonstrate a workflow suitable for dealer inventory, but availability and model coverage in Poland are unknown.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Dealer used-car manager, remarketing lead, fleet disposal manager, or buyer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Polish-language coordination, multi-vendor routing, VIN-linked verification, and dense local logistics must justify the intermediary margin
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Dealer or marketplace owns the vehicle shopper relationship; the venture's test-order relationship is not yet contracted
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Dealer-management workflow, marketplace listing enhancement, inspection referral, or buyer search

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Dealer setup, marketplace integration, referral share, and buyer search acquisition
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Customer prepays; diagnostic and logistics providers are paid at or after completion
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Likely modest per transaction unless dealer density reduces logistics and wholesale diagnostic pricing is available
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Vehicle compatibility checks, scheduling, failed tests, device recovery, and transaction support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Terms, insurance, consumer rights, data protection, fraud controls, and partner quality audits
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Target 699-999 PLN retail package or negotiated dealer volume price per completed vehicle
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Third-party test fee, device shipping, inspector travel, payment processing, and certificate verification

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Diagnostic vendors, inspection chains, dealer groups, marketplaces, and OEM dealers can sell or embed certificates directly
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A completed certificate tied to a VIN and listing is paid; the measurable loss is transaction discount, delay, or post-sale dispute caused by opaque battery condition
commercial_mechanics.payer: Used-EV dealer, fleet seller, or retail buyer
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Vehicle intake, listing creation, buyer reservation, lease return, warranty expiry, or financing appraisal
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each newly listed EV for business customers; episodic one-time purchase for consumers

contrary_evidence: The core diagnostic vendor already markets directly to businesses and consumers, limiting intermediary control.
Some OEM dealers expose battery-management-system readings at low incremental cost.
A EUR 99 anchor leaves little room for shipping, inspection, support, and acquisition unless wholesale terms or dealer density improve economics.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed nonexclusive distribution and fulfillment agreement; no dealer, marketplace, or diagnostic agreement is secured
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell direct to buyers and route tests through multiple replaceable diagnostic or inspection suppliers
critical_control_point.current_owner: The dealer, auction, listing marketplace, or buyer controls this ordering moment
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Dealer or marketplace owns the vehicle shopper relationship; the venture's test-order relationship is not yet contracted
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Public diagnostic offers and lawful outreach to Polish dealers are available; no certification technology, device fleet, or channel access is owned
critical_control_point.launch_controller: A willing dealer or marketplace plus an independent diagnostic provider
critical_control_point.renewal: Proposed annual partner renewal with per-vehicle ordering
critical_control_point.subject: Battery-test ordering position inside a dealer or marketplace transaction

economics.acquisition_route: Dealer pilots, appraisal partners, used-EV marketplaces, finance and insurance referrals, and buyer search
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Conditional path: 1,500 certificates monthly at 180 PLN contribution equals 3.24m PLN annual contribution before overhead; multi-market channel value could exceed 5m PLN, but supply terms and volume are unknown
economics.founder_time: A single-city concierge pilot can fit 3-5 hours daily if inspections are outsourced; founder-run logistics cannot scale
economics.gross_margin_basis: Selling price less diagnostic wholesale fee, device or inspector logistics, support, payment fees, and channel share
economics.payback: Per-transaction value must be proven through faster sale, lower discount, or fewer disputes; no payback evidence yet
economics.pricing: Discovery hypothesis: 699-999 PLN retail or lower dealer-volume price per completed certificate
economics.retention_or_repeat: High repeat potential at dealers and fleets; consumers are mostly one-off

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned local completion, cancellation, model-coverage, and transaction-outcome data improve routing and dealer workflow
fingerprint.customer: Polish used-EV dealers, auction operators, leasing-return sellers, and high-intent retail buyers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded dealer and marketplace checkout, appraisal partners, insurers, finance brokers, and EV-owner communities
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Battery-test ordering, device or inspector logistics, identity matching, certificate verification, and listing attachment for a per-vehicle fee
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Dealer or buyer pays when a test is completed and a transaction-linked certificate is delivered
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A used EV is listed, appraised, financed, or reserved without independent evidence of traction-battery health

founder_fit: Battery-data interpretation and transaction analytics fit data-science and finance interests
The venture can start as logistics and verification software without inventing a medical or automotive diagnostic model
Dealer throughput, completion rate, certificate attachment, and price effects are measurable
A partner-led workflow can become automated and avoids reliance on an on-camera founder brand
risks: Dependence on a third-party algorithm and certification brand
A false assurance or VIN mismatch can create costly disputes
Low local volume can make logistics uneconomic
Marketplaces or inspection chains can bypass the venture

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: per completed used ev battery certificate checkout
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: embedded test order at appraisal listing or buyer reservation
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: independent battery diagnostic technology and inspection fulfillment

structure.control_point: Distribution access at the vehicle appraisal, listing, or reservation step
structure.critical_dependency: Independent diagnostic vendors or qualified inspection partners that support the relevant vehicle models

thesis: Observed transaction and pricing signal: independent used-EV battery certificates are sold for about EUR 99, and a major diagnostic provider now offers a three-minute business test designed for dealer inventory and online used-car listings. Build the Polish ordering, device logistics, inspection-partner, and listing-verification layer so a buyer or dealer can attach a verifiable battery certificate to a specific transaction without the venture claiming to own the diagnostic algorithm.
title: Independent Battery Certificate Checkout for Used EVs
uncertainties: Number and geographic density of Polish used-EV transactions compatible with independent tests
Dealer willingness to pay versus passing the cost to buyers
Diagnostic supplier terms, device availability, and local-language support
Causal effect of a certificate on sale price, speed, financing, or dispute rates
